about_the_game:
Each Digital Deluxe Upgrade contains a digital copy of the game, an exclusive "Santa Scrooge" Ebenezer Skin, the official digital Art Book, the official Digital Strategy Guide, the official Digital Soundtrack, two Official Digital Posters - “Dark Spirit Haunts London” and “Ghosts United”- , and a digital copy of the original novel written by Charles Dickens, A Christmas Carol”, featuring completely new illustrations from Play on Worlds featuring versions of the characters from Ebenezer and the Invisible World.

Ebenezer and the Invisible World Digital Deluxe Upgrade includes all of the following:

  • Exclusive “Santa Scrooge” Ebenezer Skin - Get into the Christmas spirit with an all new "Santa Scrooge" skin
  • Digital Strategy Guide - Master Ebenezer’s abilities, weaknesses of abilities, and find tips and tricks for the Metroidvania map, Heirloom system, and more in this Official Strategy Guide written by Play on Worlds
  • Digital Artbook - Enjoy the details and elements of the art in Ebenezer and the Invisible World in this comprehensive digital artbook, designed by Play on Worlds
  • Official Digital Poster - Dark Spirit Haunts London
  • Official Digital Poster - Ghosts United
  • Digital OST - Enjoy the Victorian and Christmas themed music of Ebenezer and the Invisible World
  • Digital copy of Charles Dickens timeless origin novel, “A Christmas Carol” featuring completely new illustrations by Play on Worlds
